headline: Senior Finance & Technology System Executive/Senior NetSuite Advisor
about:
Thank you for reviewing my profile, I am open to networking with other professionals. Have a question, just ask. I'm happy to help. 

As a seasoned CFO & Technology Consultant, I'm passionate about applying my 25+ years of experience in accounting and leadership to help clients streamline operations, increase profits, and work more efficiently and effectively. My team and I enjoy helping companies improve processes, develop strategies for digital transformation, and delivering value. Implementing ERP systems around the world across a range of industries is par for the course - work I'm both knowledgeable and excited about. 

Outside of work, I appreciate quality time spent with family and friends.

experiences.description: I help CFOs successfully implement and get the most value from NetSuite

As a full services 5 Star NetSuite Solution Provider with over 400 implementations, NXTurn is more than qualified to help bring your company live on NetSuite quickly and efficiently. You can move forward with confidence knowing that you’re working with the most successful Netsuite reseller and solution provider in North America.

Concerned about implementation and integration? Don’t be! Our award winning, highly certified consultants are experts at finding opportunities to improve your business processes with a focus on delivering value. In short, our team becomes part of your team.

Selecting and implementing any new business application system isn’t easy. And ERPs and CRMs are certainly no exception. Getting stuck with the wrong provider can cost you valuable time and money. Just as many of our other clients have found, working with NXTurn makes everything as smooth and easy as possible.

At NXTurn we are committed to only working with companies in which we can provide significant value. If NetSuite is not the right solution for your needs, we’ll let you know so that you don’t waste your time and resources.

Emerald Alliance is a business consulting firm specializing in MYOB® and NetSuite® accounting, ERP & CRM software packages. 

Emerald Alliance offers a broad range of solutions for Windows and Mac users, for small, mid-size, and large companies, supported by a dedicated team of consultants and training specialists. MYOB® is a leading publisher of award-winning small business accounting and financial management software. MYOB® provides a complete networked accounting and business management solution for small to mid-size businesses. NetSuite® is a fully integrated, web-based solution incorporating CRM (customer relationship management), ERP (finance/accounting), and Ecommerce (webstore) all into one package for mid-size to large corporations

Julie has been a business consultant and internal and management accountant since 1994.  Her experience ranges from being the CFO of a multimillion dollar company to providing consulting for small to mid-ranged businesses and Fortune 500 companies.  She has focused on accounting consulting, business process flows and ERP, incorporating her Six Sigma knowledge.  Her past experience also includes 6+ years of public accounting preparing tax returns for individuals, corporations, estates and trusts.  She was also a payroll specialist and non-profit specialist.
